payload.title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Primus
payload.description:
**Problem**
Low-severity findings from the audit of Primus (develop), one checklist line each.

**Evidence / Fix** (checklist)
- [ ] /lab/* is public on primus.anth.us and its demo rows include an apparent client name (scorecards-dashboard.tsx:34); gate the route or replace with neutral demo data.
- [ ] Lorem ipsum filler in items-dashboard.tsx:122,126 and lang-graph-score.tsx:54-55; comments saying "TEST TEST" as requested; replace with real copy or remove.
- [ ] About 40 pages share the title "AI Agent Incubator"; give each page its own title.
- [ ] CHANGELOG still carries Plexus links and names; update to Primus.
- [ ] Broken relative links to primus/procedures/IMPLEMENTATION.md and README_ALIGNMENT_OPTIMIZER.md.
- [ ] The home page links to anthusai.github.io/Primus, an old Sphinx 0.1 page; remove or redirect.

**How to verify**
Each box is checked by re-running the relevant grep or visiting the URL named in it; for example `curl -s https://primus.anth.us/lab/ -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}'` returns 401/403 or the page has no client-like names.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
